name: The Shops At Carter Ranch
summary: The Shops at Carter Ranch is a community retail center located within the Carter Ranch residential development in Celina, Texas, one of the fastest-growing cities in the DFW metroplex. The center offers retail and restaurant space serving the rapidly expanding North Collin County market.
demographics: The Shops at Carter Ranch serves the rapidly growing Celina, Texas community, one of the fastest-growing cities in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The primary trade area consists of young families and professionals with above-average household incomes who have relocated to the Carter Ranch master-planned residential development. Visitors are typically homeowners aged 25-45 with children, seeking convenient neighborhood retail and dining options close to their homes. The demographic profile reflects the broader North Texas suburban growth pattern, with residents valuing quality of life, modern amenities, and family-oriented shopping experiences.
description: The Shops at Carter Ranch is a modern community shopping center strategically located at 2750 S Preston Road in Celina, Texas, serving one of the fastest-growing residential markets in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Developed and managed by Standridge Companies, this retail destination is integrated within the Carter Ranch master-planned community, providing essential retail and restaurant services to the rapidly expanding population of North Collin County. The center offers a mix of retail and dining spaces designed to meet the daily needs of local residents while capitalizing on Celina's explosive population growth. With its prime location on Preston Road, a major north-south corridor, The Shops at Carter Ranch benefits from excellent visibility and accessibility for both community residents and pass-by traffic. The development represents a strategic investment in one of Texas's most dynamic growth markets, where new residential construction continues to drive demand for neighborhood retail and dining amenities.
